name: Philadelphia Homeless Services Hotline
description: Call 211 for emergency shelter placement and homeless services. Free, confidential, available 24/7.

name: Sunday Breakfast Rescue Mission
description: Philadelphia's largest homeless shelter for men. Houses 220 men each night with dinner served 5-6pm daily.

name: Project HOME — Outreach Coordination Center
description: 24/7 homeless outreach hotline and street outreach coordination. Permanent supportive housing, medical care, and education programs.
hours: Outreach hotline 24/7; Office Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM

name: Bethesda Project — Our Brothers' Place
description: Emergency shelter for 149 men with warm meals, case management, and social services.

name: Philadelphia Public Restroom Information
description: Free public restrooms available at libraries, transit stations, and city buildings. Call 311 for locations.

name: St. John's Hospice — Day Services
description: Free showers with clean clothing. Hot noon meals for men. On-site nursing, case management, and mail services.
hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Showers Mon/Tue/Wed/Fri 8:30-9:15 AM

name: Philadelphia Public Library System
description: Public library offering free WiFi, computers, printing, restrooms, and safe indoor space.

name: Broad Street Love
description: Free clothing closet, personal care items, hygiene products, mail service, meals, case management, and legal aid.

name: The Wardrobe Philadelphia
description: Free clothing for job seekers and daily needs. Professional, casual, and formal wear. Walk-in shopping welcome.
